title: Sage behaviour_tree record
description: A behaviour_tree record (BehaviourTreeRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another behaviour_tree record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

root.description: The node it ticks: a sequence, selector, utility, decorator, task or condition. (BehaviourTreeNode)

when.description: AI conditions that must all hold for it to run (its guard).

unless.description: AI conditions none of which may hold for it to run.

score.description: Under a utility node: its score before its considerations.

considerations.description: Under a utility node: what adds to its score.

task.description: A task, such as "Wait"; its one argument is a number beside it.

set.description: A blackboard key to set to "to" (default 1).

check.description: A blackboard key: succeeds when it is within min..max (neither: not 0).

sequence.description: Each in turn; fails at the first that fails.

selector.description: The first that does not fail.

utility.description: The child whose score is highest.

invert.description: Its node, with success and failure swapped.

repeat.description: Its node again and again ("times"; 0 is for ever), until it fails.

cooldown.description: Its node, which fails for "seconds" after it finishes.

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
